arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_fraud_usd FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Sums the amounts of all transactions labelled as fraud and converts the total from cents to dollars.
assumptions: Fraud means fraud_labels.is_fraud = 1; transactions with no label are excluded.
The total is the plain sum of amount_usd_cents, so any negative amounts among fraud rows are included as recorded.
Covers the whole data period, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
